name: dsh-memoir
description: Project persistent memory and session-lessons distillation for the dsh web GUI: an agent records a session's work summary, lessons learned, and next-action guide (memoir_record) into a per-project PROJECT_MEMORY.md plus a cross-project index (~/.dsh/dsh-memoir.json), reads it back on demand (memoir_read), and has the project memory auto-injected into the system prompt of future sessions. Host-only, no client bundle 鈥?mounted via the dsh.bundle.patch manifest, no dsh source changes.
